_readme: Project A's own portfolio, read 2026-09-30 from the public Sanity dataset behind www.project-a.vc/companies (project nykgtoh6, dataset production; GROQ in sources/site/companies-flat.json, raw documents in sources/site/sanity-portfolioCompany.json). One row per portfolioCompany document (114). Fields as the firm publishes them: investedAt (year -> invest_year), projectInvestedAt (pre_seed / seed / series_a / series_b / private_equity: the firm's own claim about the round IT entered, -> stage_at_entry_site), fund (Fund I-V, 'Buyout Fund I'), status (active / exited), hq (city, country), industries and venture themes (the site's own sector vocabulary), boardMembers (the partner's persona slug), foundingTeam, founded year, website. The listing has no per-company page (cards open in place), so url is the listing.

rows.name: 11x
rows.description: 11x is an AI and automation company that builds autonomous digital workers to automate and optimise core sales, lead generation, and customer engagement processes for businesses.
rows.vision: Shaping the AI-first future of work

rows.name: Yoummday
rows.description: Yoummday provides customer experience solutions by combining a global network of freelance agents with advanced AI-powered technology, enabling companies to deliver high-quality, scalable customer service remotely.

rows.name: Claimer
rows.description: Claimer streamlines and automates the process of claiming UK government research and development (R&D) tax credits, enabling companies and advisors to submit robust, HMRC-compliant claims in a fraction of the usual time.
rows.vision: Upgrading R&D claims for venture scale startups

rows.name: Vay
rows.description: Vay is a Berlin-based tech-enabled mobility company that is on track to launch a mobility service with teledriven electric VayCars on European public streets, starting next year. The company was founded by Thomas von der Ohe, Fabrizio Scelsi, and Bogdan Djukic in Berlin in September 2018. Vay’s team wants to address the most pressing issues facing metropolitan areas around the world today, including air pollution, high costs of transportation and traffic fatalities. The Vay team combines the best of two worlds - software and product experience from Silicon Valley and automotive hardware & safety engineering from Europe.

rows.name: Micropsi
rows.description: Micropsi is a robotics software start-up that develops AI-powered vision and control systems, which enable industrial robots to adapt to changing environments and perform complex tasks that would be difficult to programme manually.

rows.name: Evino
rows.description: Evino operates an e-commerce platform specialising in making wine accessible and affordable, offering a wide selection of wines, wine accessories, and spirits delivered directly to customers' doors.
rows.vision: Online shop for curated premium wines

rows.name: Butter
rows.description: Butter is an all-in-one platform built with all the tools you need to host interactive workshops, remote design sprints and brainstormings, virtual training sessions and live courses. Butter was acquired by Miro in 2025.

rows.name: Contorion
rows.description: Contorion an online shop specialising in professional industrial and trade supplies, offering a wide range of tools, equipment, and workshop necessities to small and medium-sized businesses through an intelligent, technology-driven platform. Exited in June 2017 to Hoffmann SE.
rows.vision: Parts for pros: The one-stop shop for MRO parts

rows.name: Konges Sløjd
rows.description: Konges Sløjd designs and markets high-quality children's clothing, accessories, home products and toys using environmentally friendly materials like organic cotton, wool and wood. The brand sells through over 1,000 global retailers and its own web shops across more than 50 countries.

rows.name: Copay
rows.description: Copay connects main contractors and subcontractors through a platform that facilitates early payments in exchange for discounts, optimising cash flow for both parties. The solution reduces project costs and delays while providing subcontractors with faster access to working capital.
rows.vision: Optimising cashflow for the construction industry

rows.name: Sennder
rows.description: Sennder is a digital freight-forwarding start-up that connects commercial shippers with small freight carriers across Europe through its technology-driven platform, streamlining the booking, tracking, and management of road freight shipments.

rows.name: Anyline
rows.description: Anyline specialises in mobile data capture, providing AI-powered scanning solutions that enable any camera-equipped device to instantly read and digitise information such as IDs, barcodes, utility meters, and vehicle details.
rows.vision: Defining the future of mobile data capture

rows.name: Pactum
rows.description: Pactum leverages artificial intelligence to autonomously negotiate commercial contracts between large companies and their suppliers at scale, focusing particularly on high-volume, low-value agreements that are typically left unmanaged.

rows.name: Relay
rows.description: Relay is a logistics start-up that provides a tech-enabled delivery network designed to optimise e-commerce operations for retailers and couriers, using AI-powered technology and a decentralised, hyperlocal model to reduce costs and improve delivery speed and reliability.
rows.vision: Tech enabled end-to-end parcel delivery for e-commerce

rows.name: Onlineprinters
rows.description: Onlineprinters is one of Europe’s leading online print shops, offering a wide range of printed products such as business cards, flyers, brochures, posters, and large-format advertising systems, which customers can configure and order online around the clock.

rows.name: Riva
rows.description: Riva is redefining payments with blockchain technology, enabling businesses to send and receive instant payments at a fraction of the cost.

rows.name: Gabi
rows.description: Gabi is an insurtech start-up that automates the process of shopping for home and auto insurance, allowing users to compare multiple insurance offers and find the best rates with ease. Consumer credit reporting agency Experian purchased Gabi in 2021 for $320M.

rows.name: Trendtours
rows.description: Trendtours is a tour operator specialising in affordable group travel, offering a wide range of package holidays including bus, flight, and cruise tours, as well as wellness breaks and adventure trips.
rows.vision: Travelling done right for best agers

rows.name: Atmen
rows.description: Atmen is a regulatory technology company providing the data infrastructure that powers trusted certification of sustainable products. It focuses on automating carbon intensity certification and enabling large-scale, verifiable decarbonisation across energy-intensive industries.

rows.name: Tabular
rows.description: Tabular uses AI to automate accounting workflows, producing complete ledger entries with a single click while handling complex tasks like expense booking, VAT calculations, and transaction reconciliation automatically and accurately.

rows.name: Kyrall
rows.description: Kyrall is reinventing how functional parts are designed. Kyrall's mission is to automate the slow, complex, and costly processes of 3D functional design;  enabling engineers and designers to go from idea to manufacturable model in seconds.

rows.name: Wine in Black
rows.description: Wine in Black is an exclusive online retailer, offering a curated selection of premium wines and champagnes from renowned producers as well as exciting new discoveries.

rows.name: Bucket
rows.description: Bucket provides feature flagging and evaluation tools purpose-built for B2B SaaS product teams, enabling them to manage feature rollouts and measure customer engagement and satisfaction efficiently.
rows.vision: Helping product teams ship features that matter

rows.name: Homeday
rows.description: Homeday is a digital estate agency that connects property owners with local agents, offering a data-driven platform to simplify and digitise the process of selling and buying property while significantly reducing commission fees.

rows.name: Cosmic Lounge
rows.description: Cosmic Lounge creates mobile puzzle games in the spirit of Candy Crush. They’re reinventing game development by blending no-code tools, generative AI, and deep audience personality insights to streamline creativity, accelerate testing, and maximize hit potential.

rows.name: Flow AI
rows.description: Flow AI is a test data engine for AI agents that lets teams simulate agent behavior before production. It uses synthetic generation, production traces, and domain expert input to generate test cases that capture real-world complexity across domains. This enables faster iteration, safer deployment, and continuous evaluation as agents evolve. Flow AI is built by the team behind Flowrite – the pioneering AI email assistant, acquired in 2024.

rows.name: Tictail
rows.description: Tictail was a Swedish start-up that provided an easy-to-use e-commerce platform, enabling independent brands and small retailers to set up and manage their own online shops without any technical expertise. Tictail exited to Shopify in 2018.

rows.name: Inwerk
rows.description: Inwerk develops, manufactures, and retails innovative office furniture systems, offering a wide range of branded and own-design products through its award-winning online platform and large-scale exhibitions.

rows.name: ReStabilise
rows.description: ReStabilise is a fintech company founded by experts in digital assets, traditional finance, and regulation. Designed with a “Regulated-by-Design” approach, it aims to launch the first FCA-authorised digital-money (d-money) stablecoin,  combining the efficiency of digital assets with the safety and oversight of regulated money.

rows.name: Resi
rows.description: Resi is the UK’s leading architectural platform for homeowners, offering affordable, fast, and high-quality home extension and renovation design services through a technology-driven process.

rows.name: Resourcly
rows.description: Manufacturers are sitting on billions in idle parts and losing billions more to shortages and long-tail spend. Resourcly's AI platform transforms this hidden inventory into profit by harmonising messy and siloed data, eliminating redundancies, and recommending qualified alternatives – improving working capital by up to 15%.
rows.vision: Unlocking the value of hidden inventories

rows.name: Metycle
rows.description: Metycle is a managed marketplace to trade secondary metals internationally, connecting buyers and seller for more efficient and sustainable metal recycling.

rows.name: Modernizing Medicine
rows.description: Modernizing Medicine develops specialty-specific, cloud-based electronic health record (EHR) systems and integrated healthcare solutions designed to streamline clinical, financial, and operational workflows for medical practices. Portfolio company Klara was exited to Modernizing Medicine in 2022.
rows.vision: Delivering the next generation of specialty-specific healthcare IT solutions

rows.name: Netspeak Games
rows.description: Netspeak Games is a games studio specialising in the development of wholesome, online multiplayer games that foster inclusive and social experiences.
rows.vision: Remote-first games studio for social games

rows.name: Kry
rows.description: Kry is Europe’s leading digital healthcare provider, enabling patients to consult doctors, nurses, or psychologists online within minutes through its app, and also offering integrated access to in-person care at physical clinics in several countries.

rows.name: Quix
rows.description: Quix provides platform and open-source tools for real-time data stream processing, enabling developers and data scientists to build, deploy, and manage streaming data pipelines primarily using Python.

rows.name: Enapi
rows.description: Enapi is building the transaction broker and clearing house for the electric vehicle (EV) charging industry. Enapi effectively connects Charge Point Operators and eMobility Service Providers to enable a better charging experience for EV Drivers.
rows.vision: Transaction broker for the EV industry

rows.name: Rematiq
rows.description: Rematiq uses artificial intelligence to radically simplify compliance processes in the development of medical technology products. It translates complex regulations – such as FDA and MDR guidelines – into clear, applicable requirements and integrates them directly into existing business processes.

rows.name: Hades
rows.description: Designed for longevity, Hades is helping shape a future for mining that is sustainable, responsible, and independent. By accessing ultra-deep and stable heat reservoirs beneath the Earth’s crust without contact, Hades unlocks local geothermal energy and critical mineral extraction at a new scale.

rows.name: Knowunity
rows.description: Knowunity is a student learning platform with over 50,000 pieces of free user-generated educational content across all subjects. Operating across Europe and in South America, students can both access study materials and share their own knowledge to help others while building a follower base.
rows.vision: Learning platform by and for students

rows.name: ARX Robotics
rows.description: ARX Robotics develops autonomous, modular unmanned ground systems and sensors for both military and commercial applications, focusing on enhancing operational capabilities, productivity, and safety.

rows.name: Zenguard
rows.description: Zenguard provides multi-platform internet security software and services, most notably through its ZenMate VPN, which encrypts and secures users' internet connections to protect their privacy while browsing.
rows.vision: A real-time trust layer for AI Agents

rows.name: Valve
rows.description: Valve provides software solutions that power the global sales, marketing, and distribution of flexible workspaces, helping operators and landlords unlock lead flow, build brand awareness, and grow revenues.
rows.vision: Global industry system for flexible workspaces

rows.name: Vestigas
rows.description: Vestigas provides digital supply chain management solutions for the construction industry, enabling suppliers, freight forwarders, and construction companies to exchange delivery documentation, automate invoice verification, and analyse delivery data without the need for paper.

rows.name: Luqom Group
rows.description: Luqom Group is Europe's leading online lighting and smart home specialist, offering over 50,000 products through its multi-brand e-commerce platform. The company connects 500+ suppliers with customers across 29 countries, serving both consumer and commercial markets.
rows.vision: Europe's leading e-commerce platform for lighting fixtures

rows.name: Nu3
rows.description: Nu3 specialises in intelligent nutrition, offering a wide range of health and sports nutrition products such as supplements, superfoods, protein powders, and functional foods to support fitness, health, and balanced diets.

rows.name: Amboss
rows.description: Amboss is a digital medical resource that supports physicians in the hospital and students in the classroom, serving as an ideal clinical companion and exam preparation tool.
rows.vision: Medical knowledge you can rely on

rows.name: Ello
rows.description: Ello has developed an AI-powered reading coach and subscription service to help children from kindergarten to Year 3 improve their literacy skills through personalised, evidence-based instruction and motivation. Their mission? Unlocking the limitless potential within all children.

rows.name: Vaeridion
rows.description: VÆRIDION is transforming regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric aircraft designed for clean and affordable mobility on regional and underserved routes.
rows.vision: A 100% electric aircraft for short-haul mobility

rows.name: Black Semiconductor
rows.description: Black Semiconductor develops a new generation of microchips that integrate graphene-based photonics with conventional electronics to enable ultra-fast, energy-efficient, and scalable chip networks.
rows.vision: Inspiring the world to rethink computing

rows.name: Mister B&B
rows.description: Mister B&B is a travel platform that focuses on providing safe and welcoming accommodation for LGBTQ+ travellers, connecting them with like-minded hosts around the globe.
rows.vision: The largest gay hotelier in the world
founders: François de Landes de Saint Palais

rows.name: Toroleo
rows.description: Toroleo provided a specialist product and price comparison service focused on tyres, rims, and car parts, helping car owners find the best prices from various online retailers. It sold to Delticom in August 2014.
rows.vision: Free price comparison for car parts

rows.name: Baobab
rows.description: Baobab Insurance is a Managing General Agent specialising in digital risks, offering cyber insurance, IT liability coverage for technology and telecommunications companies, and electronic crime protection.

rows.name: Trade Republic
rows.description: Trade Republic is a German online broker and bank that enables users to invest in stocks, ETFs, bonds, cryptocurrencies, and derivatives via a mobile app, with the aim of making wealth creation accessible and affordable for millions across Europe.
rows.vision: Germany's first mobile and commission-free broker

rows.name: Kfzteile24
rows.description: Kfzteile24 is one of Germany’s leading digital platforms for automotive spare parts and accessories, offering over 3.5 million products through its online shop as well as several physical branches and affiliated workshops in Berlin.
rows.vision: The address for car parts and accessories

rows.name: Comtravo
rows.description: Comtravo simplifies business travel management for small and medium-sized enterprises by using artificial intelligence and natural language processing to automate and streamline the booking process for flights, hotels, trains, and car rentals. It was acquired by Tripactions (Navan) in 2022.
rows.vision: AI booking platform for business travel

rows.name: Re:cap
rows.description: Re:cap provides digital businesses with flexible, non-dilutive debt funding while offering a comprehensive platform to manage financial operations, liquidity, and cash flow. The software suite includes real-time financial insights and benchmarking tools that help companies optimise capital allocation and make informed financial decisions.

rows.name: Heyflow
rows.description: Heyflow is a no-code platform enabling businesses to create interactive forms, lead funnels, and landing pages using a drag-and-drop builder, helping to convert website visitors into leads, sign-ups, and sales without the need for programming.

rows.name: Laserhub
rows.description: Laserhub is a digital procurement platform streamling the ordering of custom metal parts – such as sheet metal, CNC-turned, and tube laser-cut components – by connecting buyers and suppliers through an automated, cloud-based system.
rows.vision: Platform for individual sheet metal parts

rows.name: Mindfuel
rows.description: Through its AI-driven SaaS platform Delight, Mindfuel help organisations manage and maximise the business impact of their data and AI initiatives by streamlining demand management, project tracking, and resource allocation.
rows.vision: The new home for data & AI teams

rows.name: Carl Finance
rows.description: Carl Finance provides mergers and acquisitions (M&A) and succession advisory services to small and medium-sized enterprises, offering highly professional support for business sales, succession planning, and capital raising. CARL was acquired by DoubleDigit Group in 2023 .
rows.vision: Europe's leading M&A platform for the mid-market

rows.name: Eyeota
rows.description: Eyeota is a global provider of audience data and technology solutions for digital marketing, enabling brands and agencies to enrich insights, personalise campaigns, and precisely target audiences across channels. Eyeota was acquired by Dun & Bradstreet in 2021.
rows.vision: Leading source for 3rd party audience data for advertisers

rows.name: Root Global
rows.description: Root Global helps companies in the agricultural supply chain achieve net zero by accurately measuring, managing, and reducing greenhouse gas emissions, particularly focusing on Scope 3 emissions from farming operations.

rows.name: Azowo
rows.description: Azowo provides a cloud-based SaaS platform called AZOWO Mobility Cloud that combines fleet management, vehicle sharing services for cars and bikes, and electric mobility solutions designed for corporate clients, urban areas, and local government agencies.
rows.vision: The mobility platform for fleet management and mobility sharing

rows.name: Distil Labs
rows.description: Distil Labs makes custom AI development for natural language processing (NLP) simple and accessible, enabling users to fine-tune small language models (SLMs) for specific tasks using just a few hundred examples.

rows.name: Intelipost
rows.description: Intelipost provides a comprehensive logistics and freight management platform, enabling businesses, particularly in e-commerce and retail, to streamline shipping processes through real-time freight quoting, dispatch management, delivery tracking, and invoice auditing.

rows.name: Klara
rows.description: Klara is a healthcare technology start-up that provides an end-to-end patient engagement platform, enabling healthcare organisations to communicate efficiently with patients, offer virtual care, collaborate internally, and automate front-desk tasks. Klara was acquired by Modernizing Medicine in 2022.

rows.name: Nexcade
rows.description: Nexcade builds AI agents for freight forwarders. The agents run quoting, tenders, rates, bookings and reporting with the forwarder's team visible and in control at every step.

rows.name: Kyto
rows.description: Kyto helps B2B industrial businesses enhance their international online presence and streamline lead management through targeted portal marketing and digital customer journey solutions.

rows.name: Wonderbly
rows.description: Wonderbly is an award winning publishing startup that plays in the intersection of storytelling and technology. It creates highly personalised children’s books, allowing customers to customise stories with details such as a child’s name, appearance, and interests, resulting in a unique narrative for each recipient.

rows.name: Bene Bono
rows.description: Bene Bono combats food waste by rescuing organic fruit, vegetables, and groceries that do not meet supermarket standards or are surplus, and delivering them to consumers in France and Spain at discounts of up to 40% through a flexible subscription service.

rows.name: Zepz
rows.description: Zepz provides fast, secure, and affordable international money transfer services, enabling over 8 million customers to send funds online to more than 130 countries via methods such as bank transfer, cash pick-up, mobile money, and airtime top-up.

rows.name: Labrys
rows.description: Through their secure workforce management platform, Axiom, Labrys helps organisations manage, verify, and pay their global teams while reducing costs and operational risks across challenging regions.

rows.name: Dixa
rows.description: Dixa is a customer service technology company offering a Value Experience (VX) platform that combines advanced AI with a human touch to help brands deliver seamless, personalised customer support across multiple channels.

rows.name: Scenset
rows.description: Scenset is a luxury travel-tech start-up that crafts bespoke, private travel experiences, combining the expertise of seasoned travel curators with advanced machine learning to deliver highly personalised itineraries and exclusive adventures.
rows.vision: Membership luxury travel company for individualized trips

rows.name: Minodes
rows.description: Minodes provides in-store analytics and marketing services for brick-and-mortar retailers, using Wi-Fi and sensor technology to analyse customer behaviour and optimise store operations.

rows.name: PDSG
rows.description: PDSG is Europe’s largest e-commerce company for golf equipment, operating leading online retail brands such as Clubhouse Golf in the UK and All4Golf in Germany
rows.vision: Europe’s largest eCommerce company for golf equipment

rows.name: Andercore
rows.description: Andercore is an AI-driven trade platform for industrial supply, connecting global suppliers with local buyers. Its technology manages pricing, delivery, and financing to make cross-border trade faster and cost efficient.

rows.name: Avoltra
rows.description: Avoltra helps industrial companies turn energy procurement into a strategic advantage by continuously screening markets, identifying risks and opportunities in real time, and delivering clear, tailored recommendations.
rows.vision: Turning energy procurement into a strategic advantage

rows.name: Casavo
rows.description: Casavo is a European proptech company that streamlines the home buying and selling process through a digital platform, offering instant property valuations and direct purchase offers to homeowners for a fast, hassle-free sale.

rows.name: Treatwell
rows.description: Treatwell is Europe’s leading online platform for booking hair, beauty, and wellness appointments, allowing customers to browse and book treatments at thousands of salons and spas. Treatwell exited to Wahanda in 2015 for € 34 million.
rows.vision: Marketplace for hair and beauty treatments

rows.name: Evernest
rows.description: Evernest is transforming the process of buying and selling residential properties by providing a digital platform which streamlines transactions for agents, buyers, and sellers in major European cities.
rows.vision: Redefining real estate sales – helping people find a home for life

rows.name: Spryker
rows.description: Spryker offers a composable commerce platform designed for enterprises with complex business models, enabling growth, innovation, and differentiation across B2B, B2C, and marketplace environments.

rows.name: Dalma
rows.description: Dalma is the fastest growing provider of digital, transparent pet insurance for cats and dogs, offering instant claims processing and unlimited 24/7 access to veterinary advice via its app.

rows.name: 42matters
rows.description: 42matters is a leading provider of mobile and connected TV (CTV) app intelligence, offering data-driven insights and analytics on millions of apps across major app stores and CTV platforms. 42matters was adquired by Similarweb in 2024.
rows.vision: European pioneer in mobile targeting data

rows.name: Architect
rows.description: Architect is an AI platform that automatically builds and adapts your pages for each visitor's context. Turn more traffic into conversions without touching a page builder.
rows.vision: Your website, rebuilt and personalised for every visitor

rows.name: Catawiki
rows.description: Catawiki is an online auction platform that specialises in the sale of rare, unique, and collectible items, with each lot curated and authenticated by a network of over 240 experts to ensure quality and authenticity.
rows.vision: Curated online auctions for exceptional objects

rows.name: Nettle
rows.description: Nettle is an AI-powered platform streamlining commercial insurance risk assessment, transforming week-long processes into one-click solutions that enable 5x faster inspections. The platform helps insurers underwrite business more quickly and precisely while extracting insights from historical data to bridge industry expertise gaps.

rows.name: Semasio
rows.description: Semasio is a Hamburg-based start-up that provides semantic behavioural targeting and user profiling technology for data-driven advertising, enabling marketers to reach audiences with high precision and transparency across devices and contexts.
rows.vision: User intelligent platform for data-driven advertising

rows.name: Primutec
rows.description: Primutec is a leading group of specialist companies operating across the Netherlands and Germany, providing innovative and sustainable flat roofing solutions, as well as services in lightning protection, solar PV, and green roofing.

rows.name: Crossengage
rows.description: Crossengage enables marketers to easily build and deploy AI models for customer retention, churn prevention, cross- and upselling, and lead scoring across multiple channels through its Customer Data and Prediction Platform.

rows.name: Scipio
rows.description: Scipio empowers logistics teams with a resilient, AI-driven platform that turns resupply planning from a multi-day effort into a task of minutes. With total asset visibility across national, regional, and tactical levels, seamless integration into C2 and C4ISR environments, and on-mission tracking tailored to every deployment, Scipio ensures logistics never become a bottleneck.

rows.name: Saatchi Art
rows.description: Saatchi Art is a leading online art gallery that connects independent artists with collectors worldwide, offering a wide selection of original paintings, sculptures, drawings, and fine art prints through its digital marketplace.
rows.vision: The world's leading online art gallery

rows.name: Q
rows.description: Q is building modular sensor systems that connect and combine data from different sources to give real-time intelligence for defense operations. Designed to work with both old and new technologies, its goal is to make Europe’s defense infrastructure faster, smarter, and more connected.

rows.name: Amann Girrbach
rows.description: Amann Girrbach specialises in the development and manufacture of equipment, materials, and complete system solutions for digital dental prosthetics, serving dental technicians and dentists worldwide.

rows.name: Restack
rows.description: Restack provides a backend framework for building, deploying, and scaling reliable AI agents and workflows. The platform enables engineers and businesses to create production-grade autonomous AI products with robust infrastructure, supporting Python or TypeScript development and flexible cloud or on-premises deployment.
rows.vision: Unlocking the full potential of open source products

rows.name: NWT
rows.description: NWT is a leading service provider in the German rooftop solar market, offering design and procurement services to a broad network of installers and supporting the transition to renewable energy.
rows.vision: Your partner for solar and energy projects

rows.name: Uberall
rows.description: Uberall is an AI-powered multi-location marketing platform that helps businesses boost their brand visibility, increase customer loyalty, and drive sales by managing location data, listings, store locators, messaging, local social media, and reviews across numerous directories like Google and Apple Maps.
rows.vision: Global leader in location marketing technology

rows.name: Alvin
rows.description: Alvin is a data infrastructure start-up specializing in automated optimisation and cost management for Google BigQuery environments, helping organisations reduce cloud expenditures and improve data performance with minimal engineering effort.

rows.name: Opinary
rows.description: Opinary provides interactive polling tools, enabling publishers and brands to engage audiences, gather opinions, and collect actionable first-party data directly within online content.

rows.name: Montamo
rows.description: Montamo gaps the skilled labour shortage in the renewable energy sector by training newcomers, particularly those from migrant backgrounds, to become qualified installers of heat pumps and other green technologies through a combination of digital learning and practical training.
rows.vision: Solving the shortage of workers in the skilled trades

rows.name: Loopline
rows.description: Loopline provides cloud-based software for employee feedback, performance management, and OKR (Objectives and Key Results) management, helping organisations improve collaboration, employee engagement, and development through continuous feedback and agile goal-setting.

rows.name: Mimo
rows.description: Mimo is an end-to-end business payments platform with built-in credit, designed for SMEs, accountants and bookkeepers. Instead of using fragmented tools, Mimo bundles global payment management with flexible finance, helping customers streamline financial admin, save time and money, and control their cash flow.

rows.name: Voi
rows.description: Voi is a Swedish micromobility company providing shared e-scooter and e-bike services across Europe in partnership with cities and communities. The company offers sustainable alternatives to car travel, helping reduce congestion and pollution in over 100 cities across 12 countries.
rows.vision: Shared electric scooters for Europe’s streets

rows.name: STARK
rows.description: STARK is a technology-driven defence company delivering the systems that Europe and NATO need now. Created in response to critical operational demands.
rows.vision: A new chapter in European defence

rows.name: Quantum Systems
rows.description: Quantum Systems is an aerial data intelligence company developing and manufacturing advanced electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) equipped with multi-sensor payloads for government and commercial clients.

rows.name: Unmind
rows.description: Unmind offers a mental health platform that provides science-backed tools, therapy, coaching, and AI-driven resources to help employees and organisations proactively improve mental wellbeing and unlock human potential.

rows.name: Tirendo
rows.description: Tirendo is an online retailer specialising in tyres, complete wheels, and automotive accessories, offering a wide selection of products for cars, motorcycles, and commercial vehicles across more than 25 European countries. Tirendo exited in September 2013 to Delticom.
rows.vision: E-Commerce for tires and car parts

rows.name: Navan
rows.description: Navan provides an integrated travel and expense management platform, enabling businesses to book and manage corporate travel, automate expense tracking, and enforce company policies in real time. Portfolio company Comtravo was exited to Navan in 2022.

rows.name: Waypoint
rows.description: Waypoint is a b2b marketplace offering an end-to-end solution for procuring fertilisers & commodity chemicals in international markets.
rows.vision: The international platform for fertilisers & commodity chemicals

rows.name: HomeToGo
rows.description: Home to Go is a SaaS-enabled marketplace offering the world's largest selection of vacation rentals, connecting travelers with millions of accommodations worldwide.

rows.name: Liqid
rows.description: Liqid is a digital wealth manager that provides affluent private clients with access to professional investment strategies and asset management solutions, typically reserved for high-net-worth individuals and family offices.
rows.vision: Data-driven platform for private wealth management

rows.name: Linexa
rows.description: Linexa is an AI platform that maps and unifies automation logic across every shop floor, helping manufacturers cut downtime, simulate changes before deployment, and reduce dependence on external service providers.
rows.vision: The AI Operating System for European Manufacturing
